sections.title: Food Safety Policy
sections.introduction: This section records the business's commitment to follow the food safety methods contained in this document within the areas currently supported by the system.

summary_subsection.title: Food Safety Commitment
summary_subsection.introduction: This subsection records the food safety commitment represented by this document.
policy_statements: {business_name} commits to applying the approved food safety controls recorded in this document at {site_name} for the activities and sections currently supported by the system.

sections.title: Business and Hazard Overview
sections.introduction: This section summarises the business activities and the Food Safety Profile information used to identify which food safety controls apply.

summary_subsection.title: Business Activities and Food Safety Profile
summary_subsection.introduction: This subsection records the business context and screening information used to determine which food safety controls apply.

sections.title: Temperature Control
sections.introduction: This section records the applicable methods approved by the business for chilling, cooling, defrosting and freezing food safely.

sections.title: Cooking and Reheating
sections.introduction: This section records the applicable methods approved by the business for cooking, reheating, hot holding and handling ready-to-eat food safely.

sections.title: Cross-Contamination Control
sections.introduction: This planned section will record controls used to prevent cross-contamination between raw food, ready-to-eat food, equipment, surfaces and staff activities.

sections.title: Cleaning and Disinfection
sections.introduction: This planned section will record the cleaning and disinfection methods, schedules, products and checks used by the business.

sections.title: Allergen Management
sections.introduction: This planned section will record how allergen information is managed and how unintended allergen cross-contact is controlled.

sections.title: Pest Control
sections.introduction: This planned section will record the measures used to prevent, identify and respond to pest activity.

sections.title: Deliveries and Traceability
sections.introduction: This planned section will record supplier, delivery, stock identification and traceability controls.

sections.title: Training, Responsibilities and Review
sections.introduction: This planned section will record staff responsibilities, training arrangements and the process used to review and update the Food Safety Management System.

4.1.title: Chilled Storage and Displaying Chilled Food
4.1.introduction: This subsection records the methods used to keep chilled food at safe temperatures, manage chilled storage and display, and monitor chilling equipment.

4.2.title: Chilling Down Hot Food
4.2.introduction: This subsection records the methods used to cool cooked food quickly and safely before refrigerated or frozen storage.

4.3.title: Defrosting
4.3.introduction: This subsection records how food is defrosted safely and how the business checks that food is fully defrosted before cooking or use.

4.4.title: Freezing
4.4.introduction: This subsection records how frozen food is received, prepared, stored and monitored to keep it safe.

5.1.title: Cooking Safely
5.1.introduction: This subsection records the controls used to cook food thoroughly, prevent contamination during cooking, and check that food has reached a safe condition.

5.2.title: Foods That Need Extra Care
5.2.introduction: This subsection records the additional controls used for foods that require particular care during preparation and cooking.

5.3.title: Reheating
5.3.introduction: This subsection records how previously cooked food is reheated safely and served or held without unnecessary delay.

5.4.title: Acrylamide
5.4.introduction: This subsection records the cooking controls used to reduce acrylamide formation while ensuring food is cooked safely.

5.5.title: Hot Holding
5.5.introduction: This subsection records how cooked food is kept hot safely before service and how hot-holding temperatures are checked.

5.6.title: Ready-to-Eat Food
5.6.introduction: This subsection records the controls used to protect ready-to-eat food from contamination because it will not receive further cooking before service.
